sources.name: ACSM Position Stand: Exercise and Fluid Replacement
sources.principle: Exercise fluid replacement should be individualized because sweat rate and electrolyte loss vary.

sources.name: Dietary Reference Intakes for Water, Potassium, Sodium, Chloride, and Sulfate
sources.principle: Total water includes drinking water, beverages and food moisture; AI is not an exact individual requirement.

limits: 30–40 mL/kg is an app coaching range, not a medical requirement.
Without sweat-rate data the exercise adjustment remains deliberately broad.
No dehydration percentage or exact missing liters are inferred.
